evidence: TiO2 ALD on centimeter-sized AG monoliths was performed through alternating exposures to titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) and water (H2O) in an ALD reactor at a sample stage temperature of 100 °C and a reactor wall temperature of 125 °C. Each cycle consisted of a 30 s TiCl4 pulse followed by a 120 s dry nitrogen (N2) purge and a 30 s H2O vapor pulse followed again by a 120 s N2 purge.
